decisions.reason: Substantial investment in a multi-model product line that builds on the established offer makes management reluctant to abandon it.
As a chair family close to the core seating offer, it has enough accumulated commitment to be kept despite weak results.
The multi-model floor cushion line represents considerable sunk investment and builds on existing capabilities, so escalation favors keeping it.
A single soft sofa with lower investment and less central public commitment is easier to drop when results disappoint.
A single high standing table with limited investment and lower visibility is more likely to be cut under escalation logic.
Publicly presented as a flagship and central to the firm's announced direction, the rug collection enjoys the strongest escalation and is kept.
